verdict.rationale: Docs show a default synchronous call pattern (client.parse.run returns results directly) alongside a separate async run_job()/job-ID pattern, implying a sync mode exists for interactive use, and a founder comment mentions a latency tradeoff for advanced modes — but no page documents concrete per-mode latency numbers (e.g., 'seconds') or benchmarks. Missing for 10: explicit synchronous-mode latency documentation with timing figures, side-by-side sync vs async latency comparison, and independent confirmation of interactive-speed responses.
